baslik: How a Single Step Triggers an Avalanche
aciklama:
An avalanche can be triggered by one footstep and move faster than a car. Here is the hidden science under the snow.

#shorts #science #avalanche #nature #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A single skier can bring down thousands of tons of snow.
It explodes downhill at eighty miles an hour.
The slope was not the problem. The danger was hidden underneath.
Snow falls in layers all winter long.
Between them sits a weak, sugary layer of crystals.
It holds the slab above like a house of cards.
One extra load snaps that bond and the slab slides.
Slopes near thirty eight degrees are the most dangerous.

vaka.ders: avalanche forecasting tracks buried weak layers all winter
vaka.yanilgi: In most avalanche deaths the victims triggered the slide themselves — the slope doesn't need to 'fall' on anyone.
vaka.tartisma: Would you ski a 38-degree slope if the forecast said 'moderate'?
